auth.loginDescription: Sign in with your email address and password.
auth.passwordRules: Use at least 12 characters. Repeated characters, sequences, keyboard rows, and your email address or the site name are not allowed.

reauth.title: Confirm it's you
reauth.description: Confirm your identity again before this operation.

reset.requestDescription: We will email a reset link to your registered address.
reset.requestSent: If the address is registered, we sent an email. Use the link in it to reset your password.
reset.passwordDone: Your password was changed. Sign in with the new password.
reset.mfaDescription: This removes multi-factor authentication. Then sign in with your password and set it up again.
reset.mfaDone: Multi-factor authentication was removed. Sign in and set it up again.

invite.title: Workspace invitation
invite.asNew: Choose a password to create your account.

workspaces.title: Workspaces
workspaces.empty: You don't belong to any workspace.

security.title: Account security
security.requiredDescription: This CMS requires multi-factor authentication for everyone. Other operations are unavailable until you set it up.
security.totpDescription: Use a 6-digit code from an authenticator app each time you sign in.
security.totpManual: Enter this key in your authenticator app.
security.totpOpenApp: Open in an authenticator app on this device
security.passkeysDescription: Sign in with your device's biometrics or a security key.
security.recoveryDescription: Generating new codes makes the old ones stop working.
security.recoveryCodesDescription: Shown only on this screen. Store them somewhere safe. Each can be used once.
security.passwordChanged: Your password was changed. You were signed out on other devices.

errors.generic: The request could not be completed ({status}).
errors.invalid_credentials: The email or password is incorrect.
errors.invalid_passkey: The passkey could not be verified.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a while and try again.
errors.csrf_failed: This screen cannot perform the operation. Please sign in again.
errors.weak_password: This password cannot be used. Check the rules.
errors.breached_password: This password appears in known data breaches. Choose a different one.
errors.invalid_token: The link is invalid or has expired.
errors.reauth_failed: Your identity could not be confirmed.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission for this operation.
errors.account_exists: An account with this email already exists. Sign in, then accept the invitation.
errors.already_member: You already belong to this workspace.
errors.passkeys_unavailable: Passkeys are not available on this server.
errors.mfa_already_enabled: The authenticator app is already set up.
errors.mfa_not_enabled: Multi-factor authentication is not set up.
errors.internal_error: Something went wrong on the server.
